a.lede: A suspected supply chain attack targeting Optimizely has led to malicious JavaScript being loaded on numerous popular websites, including Zoom, CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce, and GitLab, exposing visitors to scripts designed to steal cryptocurrency and payment information and exploit vulnerabilities in iOS devices. [...]
a.title: Optimizely hack infected CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce sites with malware

b.lede: The FBI says that the open-source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.
b.title: FBI says Artex AI open-source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
